findings.summary: Both firm-wide internal notices are sent to the all-staff distribution list yet open with the salutation 'Sharon,' and are written entirely as one-to-one notes to the docketing manager, so a broadcast reads as a private message.
findings.evidence: d:0002 ('Office logistics') and d:0052 ('IT maintenance window') both carry 'To: all-staff@hollowellpatent.com' but open 'Sharon,'; e.g. d:0052 broadcasts 'Please move anything due that day to before the window opens.' to the whole firm while addressing only Sharon.

findings.summary: A client email's two-item request list renders with both a dash bullet and an author-typed number on each line, a double list marker no genuine email carries.
findings.evidence: Rendered body of d:0060: '  - 1. the recorded assignments for the third family, which we understand your prior counsel still holds; and' / '  - 2. the executed side letter referenced in Section 4 of the term sheet.'
